name: Lastrup (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lastrup (a white sword between hearts and a chequy shield on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Lastrup; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lastrup arms — sword, hearts and shield on blue
